speed-dial.config.title: Speed Dial
speed-dial.config.max_speed.tooltip: Highest spectator and creative flight speed in worlds you host (singleplayer or LAN). Vanilla spectator stops at 4×.
speed-dial.config.step_mode.tooltip: Progressive: vanilla's small steps up to 4×, then multiplied on every step, set with Progressive Step. Linear: every step adds the same amount, set with Linear Step.
speed-dial.config.progressive_step.toolt: What each scroll step above 4× multiplies your speed by when Scroll Steps is set to Progressive.
speed-dial.config.linear_step.tooltip: How much each scroll step adds when Scroll Steps is set to Linear.
speed-dial.config.speed_display.tooltip: What to show above the hotbar after changing the speed. Speeds count sprinting.
speed-dial.config.match_vertical_speed.t: Fly up and down as fast as forwards, including when sprinting. Vanilla climbs and sinks slower.
speed-dial.config.remember_speed.tooltip: Keep your speed when rejoining, respawning or switching game modes, instead of resetting to 1×. In creative, every hold of the modifier starts at your last speed.
